news.title: Mako Mining Reports Q2 Gold Sales of 14,610 Ounces, Revenue of About $63 Million
Mako Mining Announces Q2 2026 Production Results with Record Gold Sold of 14,610 Au oz., Revenues of ~US$63 Million and Cash and Securities Balance of US$112 Million

Mako Mining Reports Proven and Probable Mineral Reserves of 598 Koz Au and 6.30 Moz Ag Grading 0.327 g/t Au and 3.45 g/t Ag in 56.8 M Tonnes at the Moss Mine in Arizona, Supporting a Post-Tax NPV 5% of US$254 Million and a 15-Year Mine Life at US$3,500/oz Au and US$50/oz Ag
